newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan eases limits on insurers' non-yen borrowing.
newsitem.headline: Japan eases limits on insurers' non-yen borrowing.

text.p: Japan's Finance Ministry has eased rules on foreign-currency borrowings by insurance firms to help them diversify their hedging of external assets, a ministry official said on Thursday.

The deregulation, which covers the length of time that insurers can borrow foreign-currency funds as well as instruments in which they are allowed to invest the money, took effect on April 1, the official said.
It means insurers will now be able to engage in shorter-term agreements for the foreign currency loans.
The ministry has scrapped a restriction that required insurers to borrow the money for at least five years. Now they will be able to borrow such funds for less than five years.
The MOF also scrapped a rule that restricted insurers to investing the borrowed money in Japanese government bonds and yen deposits, the ministry official said.
Life and non-life insurers are now allowed to invest the borrowings in any financial instruments whose principal is secured, the ministry official added.
The insurers are, however, still obliged to convert the borrowed foreign currency into yen before investing it.
The deregulation was in response to requests from insurance companies, which have been seeking greater flexibility in hedging their huge foreign holdings such as U.S. Treasuries, the official said.
But the changes were not expected to trigger a surge in foreign-currency borrowing by the insurance firms.

An official at a major life insurance company said the deregulation would not immediately prompt insurers to boost their foreign-currency borrowing, given Japan's low interest rates and the trend of the weak yen.

An official at another insurer said insurers rely on sales of insurance products for most of their revenues. They have been looking for other methods of raising funds to be able to deal with sudden fund withdrawals by policy holders and emergency payments. Tokyo treasury desk -81-3-3432-1396
